evidence.quote: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

**The rule was never "fewest tokens."** It is: write only what the task needs, and never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility. The code ends up small because it is necessary, not golfed. Lower cost and latency are a side effect.

The ladder runs *after* it understands the problem, not instead of it: it reads the code the change touches and traces the real flow before picking a rung. Lazy about the solution, never about reading.
Lazy, not negligent: trust-boundary validation, data-loss handling, security, and accessibility are never on the chopping block.

1193909050.summary_zh: Herdr 是运行编码智能体的运行时环境：在后台服务器中保持终端，客户端关闭或 SSH 断开时仍可继续工作；可在单一窗口管理本地与远程 SSH 机器的智能体列表；标记每个窗格的工作、阻塞或空闲状态；智能体可通过 CLI 和 socket API 创建窗格、相互提示并等待。
1193909050.audience_zh: 适合使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、Grok 等编码智能体、需要多窗格终端管理与远程机器协同的开发者；也适合构建智能体并希望接入 Herdr 的开发者。

evidence.quote: the runtime your coding agents live on

- **detach without stopping work** — herdr keeps terminals running in a background server when you close the client or lose your SSH connection. after a server or machine restart, herdr restores the saved layout and can resume supported agent sessions; the original processes do not survive. [session

- **several machines, one window** — keep local work and saved ssh machines together, with a combined agent list and independent reconnects. [remote machines →](https://herdr.dev/docs/connecting-machines/)

- **runs what you already run** — claude code, codex, cursor, opencode, grok and the rest. herdr doesn't wrap or replace them; it owns their terminals. building an agent? [add herdr support →](https://herdr.dev/docs/add-herdr-support/)

204086862.name: streamlit
204086862.description: Streamlit — A faster way to build and share data apps.
204086862.summary_zh: Streamlit 可将 Python 脚本快速转换为交互式 Web 应用，用于构建仪表盘、生成报告或创建聊天应用，并可通过 Community Cloud 部署、管理和分享。支持输入控件、数据表格、图表、布局和多页应用，编辑脚本时应用实时更新。
204086862.audience_zh: 适合希望用 Python 快速制作交互式数据应用、仪表盘或报告并进行分享的开发者与数据工作者，也适合需要让他人快速体验数据并获得反馈的原型开发者。

evidence.quote: Streamlit lets you transform Python scripts into interactive web apps in minutes, instead of weeks. Build dashboards, generate reports, or create chat apps. Once you’ve created an app, you can use our [Community Cloud platform](https://streamlit.io/cloud) to deploy, manage, and share your app.
- **Fast, interactive prototyping:** Let others interact with your data and provide feedback quickly.
- **Live editing:** See your app update instantly as you edit your script.
- **Simple and Pythonic:** Write beautiful, easy-to-read code.

488641606.name: agno
488641606.summary_zh: Agno 是自管理智能体平台：可用 Agno、Claude Agent 或 Codex SDK 构建智能体，组合成团队与工作流；通过 AgentOS 以持久服务运行，内置 API、MCP、认证、角色权限、人工审批、调度与持久执行；还可用 Company OS 将工作组织为项目、任务和例程，自动化公司运营。
488641606.audience_zh: 适合希望为公司、产品或客户构建并运行智能体的开发者和企业团队，包括需要 REST API、MCP 接入产品及 Claude、ChatGPT、Slack 等渠道，或在自有云中管控数据、查看对话与追踪、审批敏感操作并安排定期任务的人员。

evidence.quote: Agno is a self-managing agent platform. Build agents for your company, product, or customers. Run them as durable services on AgentOS. Put them to work automating company operations.
- **Run** agents as durable services with built-in API and MCP. AgentOS handles authentication, role-based access, resume/replay, human approvals, scheduling, and durable execution.

- **Automate** company operations with Company OS. Give agents responsibilities, organize work into projects and tasks, and configure recurring routines. People set direction and review results; agents own and execute.

Run your platform in your own cloud and keep your data in your control. Review conversations, inspect traces, manage knowledge, and track your agent activity using the [AgentOS UI](https://os.agno.com).

33702544.name: dash
33702544.description: Data Apps & Dashboards for Python. No JavaScript Required.
33702544.summary_zh: Dash 是一个用 Python 构建数据应用与仪表板的框架，无需 JavaScript。它基于 Plotly.js、React 和 Flask，可将下拉框、滑块、图表等 UI 元素直接连接到 Python 分析代码，支持声明式、响应式地构建含多个交互元素的复杂应用，并提供约 50 种图表类型。
33702544.audience_zh: 适合用 Python 开展机器学习与数据科学工作、需要将分析代码转化为交互式 Web 应用或仪表板的开发者与数据科学团队；开源版适合在本地笔记本电脑或工作站运行应用。

evidence.quote: Data Apps & Dashboards for Python. No JavaScript Required.
#### *Dash is the most downloaded, trusted Python framework for building ML & data science web apps*.

Built on top of [Plotly.js](https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js), [React](https://reactjs.org/) and [Flask](https://palletsprojects.com/p/flask/), Dash ties modern UI elements like dropdowns, sliders, and graphs directly to your analytical Python code. Read [our tutorial](https://dash.plotly.com/get
With Dash Open Source, Dash apps run on your local laptop or workstation, but cannot be easily accessed by others in your organization.

78243781.name: super-productivity
78243781.description: Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.
78243781.summary_zh: 一款带时间盒与时间追踪的待办事项应用，支持用子任务、项目、标签分类规划任务，通过规划器和日程时间线安排每天工作，并在看板中排序任务；可生成工时表与工作总结，提供休息提醒、专注模式与个人指标，并支持Jira、GitLab、GitHub、OpenProject等任务集成。
78243781.audience_zh: 适合希望离线、私密地管理个人工作、专注执行并记录时间的用户；也适合需要把本地任务规划与Jira、GitLab、GitHub、OpenProject等工作系统对接的开发者或团队个人。

evidence.quote: Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.
A to-do list, time tracker and daily planner for focused personal work. Private, offline-first and open source.
- **Plan ahead** with the **planner** and see your day laid out on the **schedule** timeline, next to your calendar events.
- Use **timeboxing** and **track your time**. Create time sheets and work summaries in a breeze to easily export them to your company's time tracking system.

66150122.audience_zh: 适合在终端或命令行环境中工作、追求轻量快速且少配置的用户，包括 Linux、macOS、BSD、Termux（Android）、树莓派及 WSL 等平台的使用者，以及希望借助插件与自定义补丁扩展文件管理能力的进阶用户。

`nnn` (_n³_) is a full-featured terminal file manager. It's tiny (~150 KiB), [nearly 0-config](https://github.com/jarun/nnn#quickstart) and [incredibly fast](https://github.com/jarun/nnn/wiki/Performance).

`nnn` can analyze disk usage, batch rename, launch apps and pick files. The plugin repository has tons of plugins to extend the capabilities further e.g. [live previews](https://github.com/jarun/nnn/wiki/Live-previews), (un)mount disks, find & list, file/dir diff, upload files. Runs on the Pi, [Termux](https://www.youtube.com/embed/AbaauM7gUJw) (Android), Linux, macOS, BSD, Haiku, Cygwin, WSL, across DEs or a strictly CLI env.

501045649.name: waveterm
501045649.description: An open-source, AI-integrated, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows
501045649.summary_zh: Wave Terminal 是一款开源、集成 AI 的跨平台终端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它可接入多种 AI 模型并允许使用自有 API 密钥或本地模型；提供断线后可自动重连的持久 SSH 会话、内置远程文件编辑与文件预览，以及可拖放排列的终端、编辑器、浏览器和 AI 助手区块。
501045649.audience_zh: 适合需要在 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 上频繁使用终端和远程 SSH 的开发者、运维人员，以及希望在同一界面中结合 AI 辅助、远程文件编辑与多区块工作流的用户。

evidence.quote: Wave is an open-source, AI-integrated terminal for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It works with any AI model. Bring your own API keys for OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini, or run local models via Ollama and LM Studio. No accounts required.

Wave also supports durable SSH sessions that survive network interruptions and restarts, with automatic reconnection. Edit remote files with a built-in graphical editor and preview files inline without leaving the terminal.
- Wave AI - Context-aware terminal assistant that reads your terminal output, analyzes widgets, and performs file operations
- Flexible drag & drop interface to organize terminal blocks, editors, web browsers, and AI assistants

1052845083.name: LifeOS
1052845083.description: ⛰️ LifeOS — The universal AI Harness designed to move you from Current to Ideal state in both life and work.
1052845083.summary_zh: LifeOS 是一个通用 AI Harness 与个人生活操作系统，围绕从「当前状态」走向「理想状态」这一核心概念，记录你的身份、关注点与目标，再用了解你上下文的 AI 协助推进生活与工作中的事情，覆盖开发应用、创业、创作等场景。
1052845083.audience_zh: 适合希望在生活与工作中借助 AI 推进目标、并愿意使用具备能力的 AI 编程 Harness（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等）及 bun 环境进行安装配置的用户。

evidence.quote: ⛰️ LifeOS — The universal AI Harness designed to move you from Current to Ideal state in both life and work.

**LifeOS** is a General Purpose AI Harness for doing anything you want to do in life and work with AI. It captures who you are, what you care about, and where you're trying to go, then uses AI that knows you to help you get there.
And because it has your full context, it makes everything you do more efficient and effective, from building apps, to starting a business, to creative projects…_basically anything_.
Either path needs a capable AI coding harness — we build and run on [Claude Code](https://docs.claude.com/claude-code) — and [bun](https://bun.sh).

57224308.name: activitywatch
57224308.description: The best free and open-source automated time tracker. Cross-platform, extensible, privacy-focused.
57224308.summary_zh: ActivityWatch 是一款免费开源的自动时间追踪工具，跨平台且可扩展，注重隐私。它会记录当前活动应用及窗口标题、浏览器标签页及标题和网址、键盘鼠标活动以判断是否离开电脑；数据安全存储在本地，由用户掌控，可在网页界面查看活动概览、时间线和原始事件，也可通过 REST API 和查询语言访问数据。
57224308.audience_zh: 适合希望了解自己时间去向、重视数据隐私并希望数据存储在本地的大众用户；也适合需要图形界面、可扩展追踪能力以及浏览器、编辑器等多类监控插件的人；开发者可借助客户端库和 API 编写自己的监控程序。

evidence.quote: The best free and open-source automated time tracker. Cross-platform, extensible, privacy-focused.
The goal of ActivityWatch is simple: *Enable the collection of as much valuable lifedata as possible without compromising user privacy.*
We've worked towards this goal by creating an application for safe storage of the data on the user's local machine and as well as a set of watchers which record data such as:
- Currently active application and the title of its window

309123651.name: screenity
309123651.description: The free and privacy-friendly screen recorder with no limits 🎥
309123651.summary_zh: Screenity 是一款免费、注重隐私的屏幕录制与标注工具，可无限制录制标签页、指定区域、桌面、应用或摄像头，支持麦克风与内部音频、屏幕标注、AI 摄像头背景或模糊、平滑缩放、敏感内容模糊、剪辑裁剪及导出 MP4/GIF/WebM，并可保存至 Google Drive。

Screenity is a powerful privacy-friendly screen recorder and annotation tool to make better videos for work, education, and more. You can create stunning product demos, tutorials, presentations, or share feedback with your team - all for free.
